pages.text: Broken workshops, supply depots, and road fragments lie across the plains. Mossy foundations and scattered masonry surround deserted workbenches, empty Slime Chests, lamps, and ruined storage furniture.

A surviving ordinary chest contains supplies and a written ledger. Its translated pages describe a failing delivery network and lamps left burning for an absent traveler. The buildings tell only fragments of the old kingdom's story.

Gather materials or restore a workshop for your own companions. Real Slime Chests in ruins work with your normal logistics team. Repairing the surroundings does not issue commands to companions; start each worker through its management screen.
